thread:
maria: Heads up — multiple customer reports of 503s on /api/generate across eu-west-1 and us-west-2. Incident bot did NOT page oncall for PD service. Dropping into #incidents because the bot also failed to mirror. Anyone on this?

deploy-bot: deploy/redwood-api v2.14.1 -> success (finished 1772468030)

sam: I'm seeing alert notify-service:high-error-rate firing from alertmanager. But the notify-relay logs show repeated rate-limit/ack errors. Pasting short tail: 
```
ERROR notify-relay notifier_worker: ack_rate_limit exceeded=10 concurrent_acks=12 service=pd_webhook
WARN channel-mirror mirror_post: status=429 response="rate limited"
ERROR notifier_queue: enqueue_failed err="webhook 429" attempts=3
```

kai: If channel-mirror returned 429 the bot probably marked the alert as "delivered" or suppressed further paging. That would explain oncall not getting pages. I'm going to tail the outgoing webhook queue and PD webhook responses now: `kubectl logs -f deploy/notify-relay -c notifier | grep webhook`

alex: Manual page initiated: I triggered a PD high via the PD console and used the PD API fallback: `curl -X POST https://api.pagerduty.com/incidents ... -H 'Authorization: Token token=REDACTED'` — oncall paged. Also DM'd the SRE rotation.

ops-lead: Good call. For now we should (1) bypass the mirror-to-channel check so pages still go out even if mirror fails, (2) increase ack concurrency from 10 -> 25 to avoid transient throttles, and (3) kick off manual PD incidents for any alerts that are still firing. Can someone implement (2) and restart notify-relay?

sam: Done: increased `ack_concurrency` to 25 in configmap `notify-relay-cm` and rolled the notifier: `kubectl rollout restart deploy/notify-relay`. Observed decrease in webhook 429s after backoff window — error rate on /api/generate dropped from ~12% -> ~1.8% in the last 3m. Metrics: https://grafana/redwood/alerts?panel=notify-relay-webhook-429

maria: Thanks. Who created the incident in PD so we have a single source of truth? We need a timeline for the postmortem and a customer impact summary.

incident-bot: Auto: created PD incident PDI-4521 for alert notify-service:high-error-rate. Linked runbook: notify-relay-fallback. Attempted mirror to #incidents failed with 429; retries scheduled.

alex: I'll own the hotfix PR: treat 429 from channel-mirror as non-blocking (PR #5623) so webhook mirror failures don't suppress paging. I'll include a small test harness for simulating 429s. Plan to cut a patch within the hour.

sam: Note for postmortem: root cause appears to be a burst of customer-triggered alert traffic hitting the outgoing webhook + PD backoff policy. Our concurrency limit + mirror retry logic allowed the bot to get into a state where mirror retries tied up ack slots. Action items: increase default ack_concurrency, make mirror retries non-blocking, add metric alert on `notify_relay_ack_rate_limited{service=~".*"}` and a test for webhook 429 handling.

ops-lead: I'll open the incident ticket in the tracker (INC-2026) and assign timeline + customer-impact owner. Maria, can you compile the customer impact blurb? We'll need it for support and the status page.

maria: Drafting customer impact now: "Between 09:13 and 09:39 UTC, a subset of generation requests intermittently returned 503 due to notify-relay webhook throttling causing the incident automation to fail to page and mirror. Impacted customers: three enterprise tenants in EU and US — degraded response rates (peak 12% error rate), temporary lack of automatic paging. Manual paging handled escalations at 09:18 UTC. Root-cause mitigation applied at 09:24 UTC (ack concurrency increase + relay restart). Full mitigation at 09:39 UTC after hotfix rollout." Will paste final text into INC-2026.

kai: Follow-ups assigned: (1) add non-blocking mirror behavior (PR alice/5623), (2) add prometheus alert + dashboard for ack_rate_limited, (3) add an oncall runbook step to manually trigger PD API if bot mirror fails. I'll own #2.

alex: Hotfix PR opened and merged to staging: #5623 -> rolling to prod now. Will keep an eye on channel mirror logs.

sam: Closing note — customers have been notified via support with the blurb. We should schedule a 1-hour postmortem tomorrow and include a retro on how incident automation health is monitored.

maria: Thanks everyone. Please add any additional notes to INC-2026 and tag in the postmortem invite. :white_check_mark:
